_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source presets for sql-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Declarative doc-sync leg that syncs a connection's tables into the KG as lightweight 'database_table' documents via the sql-mcp MCP server. The primary, richer path is the native typed-node tool 'sql_ingest_schema' (see sql_mcp.kg_ingest), which emits :DatabaseTable/:DatabaseColumn/:DatabaseView/:DatabaseIndex nodes with structural links; this preset is the zero-code declarative complement. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS.
